messages:
maya: Quick sync — I sketched a lightweight decision heuristic for retention exception requests so we can triage customers faster. TL;DR: three buckets (Regulatory, Legal Hold, Convenience) and an acceptance checklist per bucket.

jonah: Can you paste the checklist? happy to flag engineering constraints.

maya: Sure — paste below. This is meant for PM/Legal/Security to use, not the final self-serve UI yet.

maya: ```Acceptance checklist (draft)
- Bucket: Regulatory (e.g., FIN/HLTH): requires region lock + BYOK + SLA commit.
- Criteria: Customer contract clause + compliance officer approval + infra capacity impact analysis.
- Tech gating: KMS escrow path validated OR dedicated VPC + retention SLA defined.

- Bucket: Legal Hold: requires legal ticket, retention freeze toggle, exportability within 72h.
- Criteria: Signed hold notice + evidence export runbook + e-discovery access plan.
- Tech gating: snapshot/export tool tested on customer schema.

- Bucket: Convenience (longer retention for non-regulated): requires product-level tradeoff (cost share or tier).
- Criteria: Business case + cost model + rollback window.
- Tech gating: retention tier implemented + index aging policy.
```

samira: This is a good start. A few security notes:
- For BYOK: we need KMS attestation (HSM-backed for enterprise) and a documented rotation/compromise playbook.
- For Legal Hold exports: ensure audit trail of who requested the hold (immutable log entry).

alejandro: From legal: add a minimal template for the "signed hold notice" so PMs know what to ask. Also, any retention over 7 years -> risk review.

jonah: Engineering questions:
- How tight is the 72h export SLA? is that workable when exporting terabytes?
- For dedicated VPC requests, do we require Dedicated or is Private (VPC with shared infra) enough?

maya: Great q's. Proposal: 72h is for metadata + evidence indexes; full data export can be negotiated and may be asynchronous with a quoted ETA. For infra gating, default is Private deployment; Dedicated only when throughput/latency constraints or legal require isolation.

tess: Ops POV: we need a cost bucket and a runbook before we accept any convenience retention. If customers can't accept cost share, we queue for next-quarter pilot. Also, add a monitoring SLI: % of exports meeting 72h.

maya: Someone should own the SLI and the error budget. Who volunteers?

jonah: Eng-runtime can own initial SLI + small alerting panel. Will need a 2-week spike to estimate export perf.

samira: Security will own KMS attestation checklist and the immutable log requirement. We'll draft the HSM attestation template.

alejandro: Legal will draft the minimal signed notice template and a risk-review trigger for >7y retention.

maya: Action items:
- jonah: 2-week perf spike and rough cost estimate for export/retention tiers.
- samira: HSM attestation template + log spec.
- alejandro: signed hold template + >7y risk criteria.
- tess: ops runbook skeleton + SLI definition.
I’ll consolidate and put a decision heuristic doc in the compliance drive by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Note: @maya created doc "retention-decision-heuristics.md" in #compliance-drive at 2026-03-24 10:12 UTC :white_check_mark:

jonah: ack, will start the spike tomorrow.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone sees a missing edge case (e.g., gov procurement clauses), drop it here or add to the doc. :thumbsup:
